## The Marios
Thank you for making a pull request. Before submitting, please read through these first:

- Checking a box is placing an x into the checkbox. E.g. - [x].
- Add as much relevant information as you can. Vague or improper PRs will are ??% more likely to be closed.
- Keep a clean commit history so we don't have to Merge Commit.
- Talk to us BEFORE making any large changes, API design choices, or UX choices in general. For smaller things, it's OK to open a PR, but keep in mind that we can close PRs that we deem problematic medias.
- Pull requests which do not fill out the proper boxes will not necessarily be closed but we will laugh at you.
- Pull requests which do not delete this text will not necessarily be closed but we will laugh at you.
